answer: Proof-of-stake protocols defend AI networks against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate blocks. Similar to a reef forming a structural barrier, stake creates an economic threshold. Agents must expend resources like a garden tending to its nutrients, rather than wandering a barren tundra of free identities. This mechanism imposes a linear cost on the attacker, as creating multiple nodes requires proportional collateral that is subject to slashing upon malicious behavior.
